summary: Successfully completed E2E frontend testing of Smart Drain AI municipal infrastructure prototype. Verified login transition, Leaflet GIS OpenStreetMap rendering, statistics cards, multi-tab navigation (Dashboard, Drains, Analytics, Alerts), search & filter functionality in Drains directory, and detailed drain inspection with live ESP32-CAM visual verification and health score breakdown.
critical_code_review_comments: Code architecture is clean and well-modularized with comprehensive React components and Recharts/Leaflet integrations.
All test IDs (`data-testid`) are properly attached to interactive elements and navigation buttons.
seed_data_creation: Using robust static mock dataset in mock.js covering 847 Mumbai drains, telemetry sensors, and ESP32-CAM feeds.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All core UI workflows and component interactions verified successfully.
